arguments.command:
cd /workspace && cat /tmp/optall.log 2>/dev/null | tail -5; echo "---timing PLAN on worst case---"; python3 - << 'PYEOF' > /tmp/plan_in.txt
import sys, json, random, ipaddress
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp/tests')
import test_scale as TS
rng=random.Random(99)
case=TS.big_case(rng)
# build PLAN input for the two versions
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
from protocol import parse_request
from reference import reference_runs
import bisect
req=parse_request(json.dumps({'cases':[case]}).encode())[0]
fib={}
for route,hop in req['initial']: fib[route]=hop
hists=[dict(fib)]
for tx in req['transactions']:
    for op,route,hop in tx:
        if op=='set': fib[route]=hop
        elif route in fib: del fib[route]
    hists.append(dict(fib))
hit,miss,dec=req['costs']
lines=['PLAN %d %d %d %d %d %d %d'%(len(hists),req['cache_pages'],hit,miss,dec[0],dec[1],dec[2])]
for v in hists:
    starts,hops=reference_runs(v)
    lines.append(str(len(starts)))
    lines+=['%032x %d'%(s,-1 if h is None else h) for s,h in zip(starts,hops)]
    bl=[(rep,[bisect.bisect_right(starts,int(ipaddress.IPv6Address(a)))-1 for a in addrs]) for vv,rep,addrs in req['bursts'] if vv==len(hists) and False]
    lines.append('0')
lines=['PLAN 2 12 16 256 16 16 16']+lines[1:]
print('\n'.join(lines))
PYEOF
wc -l /tmp/plan_in.txt; time /workspace/tmp/engine < /tmp/plan_in.txt > /tmp/plan_out.txt; head -3 /tmp/plan_out.txt
